Server-Timing middleware. Records a microsecond start timestamp in req.locals; the actual Server-Timing header is emitted by response.nim's applyServerTimingHeader (called from res.send() / res.jsonRaw()), so responses sent through custom paths that bypass those procs will not carry the header. Register this middleware before any route handlers so the measured duration covers the full chain.Returns the default ServerTimingOptions; timing is disabled for production safety.Returns middleware that records the request start time in req.locals for the Server-Timing response header.Convenience overload that enables timing only when productionMode is false.

Captures _server_timing_enabled and _server_timing_start in req.locals; response.nim turns them into the Server-Timing header. Under default options (productionMode: true) this is a no-op pass-through.
